message:
I remember the last big storm that swept through our town. I found myself huddled in the living room, surrounded by my grandkids and a mountain of snacks, while the wind howled outside. I had finally taken the time to prepare—extra batteries, a few gallons of water, even a flashlight that didn’t flicker like a disco ball. 

It felt nice to be the one who was ready for once, rather than the family member everyone turned to for help. We played board games by candlelight, and honestly, it turned into one of our best nights. 

So, what's your little trick for staying calm and cozy when the weather gets wild? 🌧️
